cupertino.notes: ROUND 84 (lane y, batch 3, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the maintainer's rule (NSSplitView: no Flutter widget; HIG Split views, thin divider one point, cited). Cause of the old Rest-looking Hover, Dragged and Focus cells: the sash is laid out at two thirds of the `position` argument, and the harness pointer went to the cell centre, 30 px beside it; cup_splitter.e now aims the pointer at the divider (looks.aim). Viewed light and dark, 1x and 1.5x, all sixteen cells: thick and thin dividers, upright and lying, each at rest, hover (the 4 x 44 grip dimple in the muted label colour), dragged (accent line and grip) and keyboard focus (accent ring lines). Divider line 6C6C70 (light) and AEAEB2 (dark), peak 3.4:1 and 5:1 against the pane (was D1D1D6, 1.5:1); dimple 5:1. Thin line 1 px (cited); thick 9 px gutter with its 1 px line and the dimple are from memory (AppKit thick divider), not Apple's grip.
gaps: The thick divider's dimple is a 4 x 44 rounded grip, not Apple's pane splitter grip
The divider line is darker than separatorColor so the control holds 3:1
No Apple-rendered image to measure against: every status here is derived from published iOS 17 / macOS 14 numbers, never matched to a real control

Segoe UI stands in for SF Pro (no SF-like font is installed on this Windows host: C:/Windows/Fonts holds Segoe UI, Arial, Tahoma and Roboto only); sizes are SF sizes, glyph shapes, widths and the semibold weight is Segoe UI Semibold (seguisb.ttf, all Cupertino sheets since round 82 v; only weight 700 draws Bold) are not
Corners are circular arcs, not the continuous (squircle) curve; no blur or vibrancy: shadows are stacked low-alpha shapes, translucent materials are flat near-opaque faces
Audit 3: only rendering and contrast were measured; pixel fidelity to a platform reference is unverified (no live reference exists)
